notes: Embedded FalkorDBLite: no HNSW vector index — vector runs brute-force; the FULLTEXT index EXISTS on embedded (indexes.fts=true; FTS populated 40/100 queries in the committed baseline) and structural populates only for kind-carrying queries. FTS/structural columns on embedded runs are measurement-environment artifacts, not quality statements — Docker FalkorDB >= 4.x is authoritative.
On embedded, fused RRF is NOT vector alone — per-query data shows FTS populated 40/100 queries and fused != vector on 17/100 (fused-vs-vector nDCG@10 delta CI -3.25..-0.83, excludes 0).

Embedding space (provenance.corpus_embedding_space): corpus and query vectors are ALWAYS produced in ONE space. No model loaded → 'oracle-synthetic' (topic-centroid sums from the oracle structure + seeded noise; the documented degraded fallback). Model loaded → 'model', and the seeded corpus is RE-EMBEDDED with that same model (provenance.corpus_reembedded) so the arm is real semantic retrieval. Never one side each: that compared bge text vectors against centroid vectors and reported a 37-point nDCG 'regression' on unmodified code.

The gate REFUSES a cross-space comparison (verdict INCOMPARABLE) — paired deltas across two embedding spaces measure the instrument, not the change. Baseline files carry their own space; re-baseline in the space you measure.

R@10 uses the oracle denominator = the grade-2 target set (~77-84 points at corpus 2000/24 topics) — the ceiling is 10/|target| (~12%), so compare R@10 RELATIVELY across strategies; the recall diagnostic for retrieval-gap filing is in the top-50 pool.

#2678: the 'tfidf' arm is the SPARSE sklearn TF-IDF leg, pinned with force_sparse=True — deterministic and embedder-independent. It is NEVER the embedder-gated scorer, so it cannot collapse into a second semantic arm when the bge embedder is cached.
Authored queries: relevance is subjective → LLM judges + owner adjudication (judge.py); baseline reports them labels_pending until the emitted pool is judged and merged via --judge-labels.
Paired deltas (fused vs per-strategy, rerank verdict, and gate-vs-baseline) are 90% paired bootstrap CIs on per-query deltas in POINTS (x100).

#1348 pool-semantics note: eval depth == eval limit (no x2 in this harness); SDK str_limit = limit x2, floored by the product's baked pool depth 120 (#1947/G2; TORTOISE_POOL_FLOOR overrides). --limit = returned limit (metrics are top-limit), --depth = per-strategy retrieval depth; all depth/k/GraphRanker measurements here are 2-strategy fusion (RRF fts+vector) on a kind-less corpus (structural dead), while production fuses 3 strategies — the floor default for 3-strategy production is a projection.

#1348 k_sweep: fused@{20,60,100} computed from IDENTICAL lists (paired by construction); k-verdict interpretable only where >=2 strategies populate (population_counts self-declare authority). fused key is the k=60 alias (gate compat).

#1348 fused_rerank arm: fuse -> truncate to limit -> rerank (production order sdk.py::TortoiseSDK.tortoise_fts_query); corpus-variant enhanced seeds topic-correlated EP (n.confidence + edges, no new nodes); oracle-proxy = query-conditioned positive control (stub projection, graph_boost_weight=1.0); enhanced-conf-only is a RANKER-LEVEL ablation (corpus identical to enhanced; the ranker neutralizes the degree term via use_degree=False so the boost is confidence-only).
